description: Search Germany's federal job board and Austrian AMS listings by keyword, location, occupation or job URL.

careerChanger.description: Only jobs marked as suitable for people changing careers (Quereinstieg).
careerChanger.title: Suitable for career changers

disabilityFriendly.description: Only jobs aimed at severely disabled or equivalent applicants.
disabilityFriendly.title: For severely disabled people

employer.description: Exact employer name as shown on Arbeitsagentur, e.g. Deutsche Bahn AG.
employer.sectionDescription: Optional exact-match filters from the Arbeitsagentur catalogue.
employer.title: Employer name

excludeExternalBoards.description: Hide postings that only link to a third-party job board.
excludeExternalBoards.title: Exclude external job boards

homeOffice.description: Require home office or a minimum home-office share.
homeOffice.title: Home office

includeDetails.description: Adds description, all work locations, contact details, flags and the employer profile. Uses one extra request per job.
includeDetails.sectionDescription: Control how much data is collected for each job.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full descriptions and employer profiles

jobLocation.description: Exact city filter, e.g. Wien or Berlin. Use this for Austrian cities.
jobLocation.title: Job location (exact city)

jobType.description: Regular jobs, apprenticeships, internships or self-employment.
jobType.sectionDescription: Narrow the search with the filters below.
jobType.title: Offer type

jobUrls.description: Paste Arbeitsagentur job URLs or reference numbers to fetch those postings directly. When filled, the keyword search is skipped.
jobUrls.sectionDescription: Fetch specific postings instead of running a search.
jobUrls.title: Job URLs or reference numbers

location.description: City, postal code or region to search around, e.g. Berlin, 10115, Bayern. For all Austrian jobs use Österreich.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Stop after this many jobs. Arbeitsagentur returns at most 10,000 results per query.
maxItems.title: Maximum number of jobs

occupationField.description: Exact occupation field, e.g. Informatik or Softwareentwicklung und Programmierung.
occupationField.title: Occupation field

privatePlacementOnly.description: Only postings from private recruitment agencies (Personalvermittlung).
privatePlacementOnly.title: Private recruitment agencies only

publishedWithin.description: Only jobs published in the selected window. Arbeitsagentur supports today, 1, 7, 14 and 28 days.
publishedWithin.title: Published within

radius.description: Radius around the location. Only applied when a location is set.
radius.title: Search radius (km)

salaryDisclosure.description: Only jobs that disclose an annual salary or an hourly wage.
salaryDisclosure.title: Salary disclosure

search.description: Words to search for in job titles and descriptions, e.g. Softwareentwickler, Krankenpfleger, Lagerhelfer. Leave empty to browse all current postings.
search.sectionDescription: Search by keyword, or paste job URLs below to skip the search.
search.title: Search keyword

workingTime.description: Full-time, part-time, shift work, home-based work or minijob.
workingTime.title: Working time

title: Arbeitsagentur Job Finder Input
